verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) titled as the official documentation index. It is backed by many topic-specific agent-oriented text files under /llms/ covering the HTML API, data extraction, JS scenarios, proxy mode, dedicated search and ecommerce APIs, and the CLI. An agent can be pointed directly at these. Missing for 10: markdown versions of the main docs pages (documentation.md returns 404) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.scrapingbee.com/llms.txt # ScrapingBee Documentation
Use `extract_rules` for CSS/XPath-based extraction and `ai_query` or `ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction.
JavaScript rendering is enabled by default.
